mentions.name: Sortberry
mentions.description: This AI automation finds cool events and things to do in Stockholm and updates the Sortberry website every night. It also automatically publishes the top 5 events to Instagram, using Gemini's Nano Banana model to generate event posters for the posts.
mentions.source_excerpt: I build an AI automation that finds cool things to do in my city, which is stockholm and updates the website every night along with updating the website with the events it also automatically publishes top 5 events to instagram.
